title: CNA Shift Observation and Condition Report
brief: Shift condition and observation report drafted by a CNA for the charge nurse regarding an 81-year-old long-term care resident with diabetes and heart failure.

slip.document:
# CNA Shift Observation and Condition Report
Facility: Redwood Crest Senior Living
Date: 04/14/2026
Shift: Day (06:30 - 15:00)
Reporting CNA: Tyrone Okafor, CNA
Assigned Charge Nurse: Naomi Quinn, RN
Resident: Samuel Ellison | Room: 214-B | DOB: 11/03/1944

## Baseline Reference Data
| Measure | Baseline Value |
| --- | --- |
| Diet | Low sodium, consistent carbohydrate |
| Weight | 178.4 lb (04/07/2026) |
| Transfer Status | One-person assist with gait belt |
| Cognition | Alert and oriented x3, cooperative |

## Objective Shift Observations and Vitals
| Parameter | 07:15 | 11:30 | 14:00 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Blood Pressure | 134/82 mmHg | 138/84 mmHg | 132/80 mmHg |
| Heart Rate | 74 bpm | 76 bpm | 72 bpm |
| Respiratory Rate | 16 breaths/min | 18 breaths/min | 18 breaths/min |
| SpO2 | 97% on room air | 96% on room air | 97% on room air |
| Morning Weight | 184.2 lb | -- | -- |

## Intake and Output
- Meal intake: Breakfast 75%, Lunch 50%.
- Fluid intake: 240 mL water at breakfast, 120 mL cranberry juice at lunch.
- Urine output: Voided x2 in commode with assistance, approximately 450 mL total, clear amber.
- Bowel movement: Small formed stool at 08:30.

## Physical Symptoms and Resident Complaints
- Lower extremities: Pitting edema noted in bilateral ankles and lower calves, rated 2+ with visible sock indentations.
- Skin integrity: Intact, warm, and dry throughout bilateral lower extremities.
- Resident stated at 11:15 that his walking shoes felt much tighter than usual and requested to stay in his recliner.
- Morning weight of 184.2 lb demonstrates expected stable weight maintenance compared to last week.

## Actions Taken and Escalation
- Elevated bilateral lower extremities on two pillows while resident rested in recliner after lunch.
- Assisted resident with partial bed bath and scheduled repositioning at 13:00.
- Applied resident compression stockings over bilateral lower extremities without skin inspection prior to recliner rest.

errors.quote: Morning weight of 184.2 lb demonstrates expected stable weight maintenance compared to last week.
errors.explanation: A jump from 178.4 lb on 04/07 to 184.2 lb on 04/14 is an acute 5.8-pound weight gain in one week accompanied by bilateral pitting edema, which directly contradicts the conclusion of stable weight maintenance.
errors.fix: Morning weight of 184.2 lb demonstrates a 5.8 lb acute weight gain compared to last week.

errors.quote: Applied resident compression stockings over bilateral lower extremities without skin inspection prior to recliner rest.
errors.explanation: Applying compression stockings over lower extremity edema requires a mandatory skin inspection for breakdown, redness, or skin tears prior to application to ensure resident safety.
errors.fix: Completed skin inspection confirming no tears or breakdown and applied resident compression stockings over bilateral lower extremities prior to recliner rest.
